security_passwordstrength_tip: Length of TeamViewer random session password. Disabled and Low are weakest. High is 10 characters.
is_not_first_run_without_connection: Is Not First Run Without Connection
owning_manager_account_name_tip: TeamViewer account that owns this device
owning_manager_company_name_tip: Company of the TeamViewer account that owns this device
unmanaged_tip: Whether this device is assigned to a TeamViewer company
buddy_login_name_tip: TeamViewer account signed in on this Mac
buddy_display_name_tip: Display name of the signed-in TeamViewer account
edition_tip: TeamViewer product from a known Version suffix only. Host (H) is for unattended access. Custom Host (HC) is a company-branded Host. Blank means the preference did not identify the product.
interface_tip: TeamViewer window style. New is the current interface (UIVersion 4). Classic is the older interface (UIVersion 2).
widget_update_available_tooltip: Shows whether TeamViewer reports an update is available. Red indicates an update is available, green indicates no update.
widget_management_tooltip: Shows whether devices are assigned to a TeamViewer company. Yellow means unmanaged or not reported (treated as unmanaged). Green means prefs report managed.
widget_always_online_tooltip: Shows Always Online status. Yellow means prefs report Always Online on. Green means off or not reported (treated as off).
widget_password_strength_tooltip: Shows random session password strength. Red is Disabled or Low, yellow is Medium, green is High (10 characters).
widget_version_tooltip: Shows TeamViewer client version distribution across all clients. Click a bar to open the listing filtered to that version.
